banner.title:
A year
in frames.
banner.lede: Selected weddings, events, and editorial work — each collection opens to its own gallery.

collections.title: Wedding days
collections.description: Twelve weddings from this season — Provence, Como, Kyoto, Mallorca. Documented slowly, with film and patience.

collections.title: Editorial events
collections.description: Brand dinners, gallery openings, private salons. Eight stories from rooms briefly occupied.

collections.title: Quiet elopements
collections.description: Twelve guests or fewer. Anywhere on the map — the smaller the room, the closer the photograph.

collections.title: Bridal portraits
collections.description: The hour before the door opens. Studio sittings and on-location portraits before the day begins.

collections.title: Film & cinema
collections.description: Super-8 and 16mm transfers — six-minute story films, scored, hand-edited from a season's footage.
